meta.rule: A hotel is usable for an 8 AM–close day only if the walk from the lobby to the poker room can be completed inside 30 minutes.
meta.how_to_close: Run the same hotel↔venue pairs through the Google Maps Distance Matrix API (mode=walking) or Apple Maps directions, store the returned duration plus the request timestamp, and paste those pairs into data/walks.json. The ≤30-minute filter then becomes a hard filter instead of a warning.

Wynn to the Venetian poker room: no official walking-time source; ~2.2 miles of Strip frontage between the two resorts by public mapping, so it is not a plausible walk-to-play pairing anyway.
Encore is connected to the Wynn tower that hosts the poker room; the property publishes no minute count.
Bellagio sits across Las Vegas Boulevard from The Cosmopolitan and is one property away from the Venetian complex; no official minute count exists.
ARIA to the Venetian runs along the Strip through CityCenter; no official minute count. The Aria Express tram is free but does not reach the Venetian.
TI is directly across Las Vegas Boulevard from the Venetian/Palazzo complex; the property publishes no walking minutes and the crossing + Strip walk is not time-verified here.
